questions.title: How do you verify governance and compliance with security standards?
questions.description: Manufacturing customers face unique challenges in securing workloads due to the convergence of IT and OT. Security in this environment must account for legacy protocols, isolated control systems, and real-time operational constraints. The following best practices provide guidance to implement robust governance, maintain compliance, and operate securely on AWS.

choices.title: Create a security Shared Responsibility Model

helpfulResource.displayText: Define and document a customized Shared Responsibility Model (SRM) that explicitly separates the security responsibilities between cloud environment, IT, and OT stakeholders. This provides clarity when managing security across cloud, edge, and on-premises industrial assets.

improvementPlan.displayText: MIDASEC01-BP01: Create a security Shared Responsibility Model

choices.title: Standardize security baseline and implement role-based access controls

helpfulResource.displayText: Establish a standardized security configuration across accounts and workloads using AWS Organizations, AWS IAM, and control policies. Implement role-based access controls (RBAC) to limit access based on job function and responsibility, especially across IT and OT environments.

improvementPlan.displayText: MIDASEC01-BP02: Standardize security baseline and implement role-based access controls

helpfulResource.displayText: Help protect communication between devices and systems in industrial settings by securing machine-to-machine (M2M) and human-to-machine (H2M) access using authentication, authorization, and encryption methods tailored to industrial protocols and devices.

improvementPlan.displayText: MIDASEC01-BP03: Secure machine-to-machine and human-to-machine access

choices.title: Automate monitoring and reporting with cloud-ready compliance tools

helpfulResource.displayText: Automate the collection, evaluation, and reporting of compliance evidence using AWS Cloud tools. Tailor configurations to meet industry-specific regulatory requirements such as NIST, CMMC, or ISO and IEC standards for manufacturing.

improvementPlan.displayText: MIDASEC01-BP04: Automate monitoring and reporting with cloud-ready compliance tools

helpfulResource.displayText: Develop and test incident response playbooks for common OT/IT scenarios such as device compromise, unauthorized access, and data exfiltration. Verify your cross-functional coordination and readiness to minimize downtime and safety risks.

improvementPlan.displayText: MIDASEC01-BP05: Implement incident response playbooks
